scientific_role: describe why the frozen development nomination gate failed; not a new method, threshold, or confirmation

generation_failures.shared_reason: fewer than five unique complete training environment prototypes after applying the frozen strict historical evidence and terrain extraction

interpretation: Environmental support clearly beats uninformed spatial placement, so the regional environmental geometry is not empty signal. However nearest-known remains the stronger local comparator overall, especially in the animal subset. The failure therefore points to a missing local-process representation rather than a need to retune the validated regional support fraction. A future local-discovery method must add source-backed structural or continuity information and beat nearest-known on a new disjoint cohort; simply reusing the regional environmental-support rule is not sufficient.

do not tune a distance/environment weight on these 96 opened pairs and present it as validated
